🏗️ TigerGraph Native Schema & MCP Architecture

End-to-end integration diagram showing GraphRAG, GSQL queries, Model Context Protocol, and multi-tier approval routing.

● GSQL Graph Schema (6 Vertices, 4 Edges)

VERTEX Customer (id STRING, name STRING)
VERTEX Card (id STRING, card_type STRING, billing_region STRING)
VERTEX Transaction (id STRING, amount DOUBLE, timestamp DATETIME, is_online BOOL)
VERTEX DeviceProfile (id STRING, os STRING, browser STRING)
VERTEX IPAddress (id STRING, country STRING, is_proxy BOOL)
VERTEX CaseVertex (id STRING, verdict STRING, timestamp DATETIME)
DIRECTED EDGE HAS_CARD (FROM Customer, TO Card)
DIRECTED EDGE PERFORMED_TXN (FROM Card, TO Transaction)
DIRECTED EDGE USED_DEVICE (FROM Transaction, TO DeviceProfile)
DIRECTED EDGE CITES_CASE (FROM CaseVertex, TO CaseVertex)

● TigerGraph MCP Tool Endpoints

card_window(card_id, hours=48)

Fetches all transactions on the card within a 48-hour temporal window to evaluate velocity.

device_neighbors(device_id, hops=2)

Multi-hop graph query discovering all cards sharing endpoint fingerprint D13840.

customer_history(customer_id)

Aggregates 6-month historical baseline across 590,742 transactions to eliminate false positives.

upsert_case_memory(case_id, verdict, precedents)

Creates live CaseVertex and CITES_CASE edges so subsequent alerts cite past precedent.

⚖️ Bank Fraud Policy Engine (Rules R1 through R10)

Rule R1
Solitary high risk score without corroborating graph evidence shall NEVER trigger hard card block.
Rule R3
Confirmed customer report with matching device collision mandates immediate card block (L1 approval).
Rule R7
Exposure exceeding $10,000 across connected syndicate cards requires mandatory FinCEN SAR Part V.
Rule R8
All final post-verification actions must document explicit 'what_changed' rationale in case record.
Rule R9
Unrecognized fraud topologies must be flagged as 'undocumented' and escalated for policy review.
